Drifting

Slide with speed. Control the angle. Master every corner.

Explore Drifting

The Drift Experience

Speed.Angle.Control.

Drifting is a test of speed, precision, and car control. Drivers intentionally push the car into oversteer, holding a controlled slide through each corner.

  1. 01

    Control the Slide

    Maintain the perfect drift while keeping the car under control.

  2. 02

    Master the Angle

    Every corner demands the right balance of speed and steering.

  3. 03

    Tandem Competition

    Drivers can compete in one or two runs, showcasing their drifting skill against the competition.
